protocol.timing: Synchronous public calls plus retaining each returned value in a preallocated array
protocol.excluded: Process/import startup, input construction, native replay, setup, complete guards, disposal, statistics and I/O
protocol.statistics: True median and nearest-rank p95/p99 of batch means in microseconds per operation
protocol.memory: Signed net Node heapUsed delta per batch; includes GC and excludes many ArrayBuffer/native allocations
protocol.scheduling: One child at a time; controls precede the candidate-only generation process; no reruns or adaptive counts
protocol.qualification: Existing reader controls and new JavaScript feature costs only; no cold-start or native execution timing
